description: This is a CMake module script for finding and configuring the OpenSSL libraries and executable paths, especially handling different versions and platforms.

methods.name: find_program
methods.description: Locates the OpenSSL executable in specified hints and paths.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks a variable as advanced to hide it by default in CMake GUIs.

methods.name: find_file
methods.description: Searches for the specified library files within given paths.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs debug, verbose, or message information during configuration.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Removes variable values or cache entries.

methods.name: string(REGEX MATCH ...)
methods.description: Performs regex matching on strings to parse version info.
